scope: separates proven defects, documented gaps and required contracts

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: Code 52 was interpreted as physical exclusivity failure despite a later explicit missing-evidence limitation.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Do not adjudicate A without same-object, same-interval, same-access evidence.
defects.FIX: Add conservative adjudication; preserve historical receipts.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: Logical filename / common path can be confused with opened object identity.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Require expected path plus volume/file ID cross-source and process binding.
defects.FIX: Offline contract added; native collector/source repair BLOCKED.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: Persistent READY and GUI liveness do not prove uninterrupted handle ownership at attempt.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Require acquisition < attempt < release and external continuous-handle witness.
defects.FIX: Offline contract added; native timing/collector verification BLOCKED.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: RunId, role, process creation, time and path need independent expected plan.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Bind plan and MQL/external observations; reject missing evidence and duplicate keys.
defects.FIX: Offline contract and negative controls added.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: Release/reacquire without token/epoch permits wrong-owner or ABA interpretation.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Release token and epoch match acquired owner; next owner differs and epoch increases.
defects.FIX: Offline contract; production protocol only evaluated, no Candidate3 changes.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: PS007 visits function blocks only; Stop-Process at top level escapes the rule.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: AST-based traversal of all executable command nodes and guarded call sites required.
defects.FIX: Detection/reproducer added; original immutable gate preserved. Latest R1 source unavailable, repair not claimed.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: PS009 searches try{ and catch{ substrings, including comments; it does not establish a top-level exception envelope.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Parse Windows PowerShell AST and prove required entrypoint covered by TryStatementAst/catch/finally.
defects.FIX: Detection/reproducer added; AST implementation/native testing BLOCKED.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: Branch stores qualifier package hashes/reports without qualifier/runner exact source or carrier. Library cannot be queried in this session.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Before release require source blobs/package carrier materialization and SHA checks, not a receipt alone.
defects.FIX: Record missing identities; no invented replacement or release.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: Current runtime is Linux, native tools absent and no callable Windows bridge.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Fresh target capability receipt before R2 execution.
defects.FIX: Fail closed; persist nonexecution receipt and unobserved fingerprint.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: Python bool compares equal to integer 1; release epoch needed strict type check.
defects.FIX: Strict type check added to release ownership validation.

defects.ROOT_CAUSE: An array of 64 hexadecimal characters could satisfy len/all checks without being a hash string.
defects.DETECTION_RULE: Require str before length and alphabet checks.
defects.FIX: Strict string check added to raw trace hash validation.
